label: AB4C_oC24_36_a_4a_a-002
title: BaZnF$_{4}$ Structure
comments:
While many of the listed compounds have a phase transition under pressure the do not necessarily transform into the same structure. 
 Above 5 GPa BaZnF$_{4}$ transforms into its \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_mP24_7_2a_8a_2a-001}{high pressure structure}. (Posse, 2011) 
 We use the data from (Lapasset, 1996) taken at 295K. 
 Space group $Cmc2_{1}$ \#36 allows an arbitrary choice of the origin of the $z$-axis.  Here we set $z_{6} = 0$ for the zinc (2a) site.
